{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kurual'grast Mountains''' were located on the planet of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. [[Drev'starn]], the capital of Bothawui, was located in the foothills of this mountain range, as was the planets largest [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]]. The grandest homes of Drev'starn were located high atop the treacherous cliffs and passes of the mountains. Here the wealthiest clans maintained impressive holdings; some dated back to the earliest times of [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] civilization.
